title: Ink blot
pitch: A blot of ink, folded and opened, made only for you. Look at it and say what you see. There are no right answers.

cards.prompt: A blot of ink, folded and opened, made only for you. Look at it and say what you see. There are no right answers.
How do you feel right now?
cards.why: A number before and after shows what a few quiet minutes did.

cards.prompt: Take a slow look. Let it be anything.
cards.why: What you notice is yours, and it's worth noticing.
Whatever you see first is a good place to start talking from.

cards.prompt: Look again. What else do you see?
cards.why: A second look often finds what the first one walked past.
How it feels can say as much as what it looks like.

cards.prompt: Say a little more about that feeling.
cards.why: Putting it into words can show you where else you've felt it.
